info.name: AI Drama public API
info.description: HTTP checks against the running development API and its MySQL database. Requires public dramas with free/paid episodes and previews, plus the documented zero-balance point error fixture. Does not download signed media URLs.

exec: pm.test("API does not return a server error", () => {
pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.below(500);
if (pm.response.code === 200 && pm.info.requestName !== "Root" && /application\/json/i.test(pm.response.headers.get("Content-Type") || "")) {
pm.test("Public response shapes and identifiers follow the API contract", () => {
function check(value) {
if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.forEach(check);
if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return;
if ("uuid" in value) {
pm.expect(value.uuid).to.match(uuid);
pm.expect(value).not.to.have.property("id");
if ("imageUrls" in value) {
["slug", "title", "shortDescription"].forEach(key => pm.expect(value[key], key).to.be.a("string"));
pm.expect(value).not.to.have.property("images");
["poster", "posterLandscape", "homeHero", "detailCover"].forEach(key => {
const url = value.imageUrls[key];
pm.expect(url === null || (typeof url === "string" && /^https:\/\//.test(url)), key).to.equal(true);
pm.expect(value.imageUrls.campaigns).to.be.an("array");
value.imageUrls.campaigns.forEach(url => pm.expect(url).to.match(/^https:\/\//));
pm.expect(value.previewVideos).to.be.an("array");
value.previewVideos.forEach(video => {
pm.expect(video.storageKey).to.be.a("string").and.not.be.empty;
pm.expect(video.durationMs).to.satisfy(Number.isInteger).and.be.above(0);
pm.expect(video.isSaved).to.be.a("boolean");
pm.expect(value.genres).to.be.an("array");
const genreIds = JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get("genreIds"));
value.genres.forEach(genre => {
pm.expect(genreIds).to.include(genre.id);
pm.expect(genre.code).to.be.a("string");
pm.expect(genre.name).to.be.a("string");
const count = value.episodeCount ?? value.publishedEpisodeCount;
if (count !== undefined) {
pm.expect(count).to.satisfy(Number.isInteger).and.be.at.least(0);
pm.expect(value.freeEpisodeCount).to.satisfy(Number.isInteger).and.be.within(0, count);
Object.values(value).forEach(check);
check(pm.response.json());

item.name: Login returns admin user, points, and tokens

exec: pm.test('Admin login returns public fields and an access/refresh pair', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(Object.keys(body).sort()).to.eql(['accessToken','accountType','availablePoints','displayName','expiresIn','refreshToken','uuid']); pm.expect(body.uuid).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.accountType).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.availablePoints).to.be.a('number').and.at.least(0); pm.expect(body.accessToken).to.be.a('string').and.not.be.empty; pm.expect(body.refreshToken).to.be.a('string').and.not.be.empty; pm.expect(body.expiresIn).to.equal(900); pm.expect(body).not.to.have.property('password'); pm.expect(body).not.to.have.property('id'); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.has('Set-Cookie')).to.equal(false); pm.collectionVariables.set('loginUserUuid', body.uuid); pm.collectionVariables.set('loginAccessToken', body.accessToken); pm.collectionVariables.set('loginRefresh0', body.refreshToken); const parts = body.refreshToken.split('.'); parts[2] = (parts[2][0] === 'A' ? 'B' : 'A') + parts[2].slice(1); pm.collectionVariables.set('tamperedRefresh', parts.join('.')); });

item.name: Attacker-first refresh is revoked when the user retries the old token

exec: const send = options => new Promise((resolve, reject) => pm.sendRequest(options, (error, response) => error ? reject(error) : resolve(response)));

(async () => { const baseUrl = pm.variables.replaceIn('{{baseUrl}}'); const login = await send({ url: baseUrl + '/auth/login', method: 'POST', header: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ loginId: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{entitledLoginId}}'), password: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{entitledPassword}}') }) } }); const oldToken = login.json().refreshToken; const rotate = token => send({ url: baseUrl + '/auth/refresh', method: 'POST', header: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ refreshToken: token }) } }); const attacker = await rotate(oldToken); pm.test('Attacker-first refresh receives the first successful rotation', () => pm.expect(attacker.code).to.equal(200)); const victimRetry = await rotate(oldToken); pm.test('Victim retry detects the replay and revokes that login', () => { pm.expect(victimRetry.code).to.equal(401); pm.expect(victimRetry.json().errorCode).to.equal('AUTH_INVALID_TOKEN'); }); const newest = await rotate(attacker.json().refreshToken); pm.test('The attacker-first response token is rejected after replay detection', () => pm.expect(newest.code).to.equal(401)); })().catch(error => pm.test('Attacker-first refresh scenario completes', () => { throw error; }));

item.name: Concurrent refresh permits one response and revokes the resulting session on replay

exec: const send = options => new Promise((resolve, reject) => pm.sendRequest(options, (error, response) => error ? reject(error) : resolve(response)));

(async () => { const login = await send({ url: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{baseUrl}}/auth/login'), method: 'POST', header: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ loginId: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{entitledLoginId}}'), password: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{entitledPassword}}') }) } }); pm.test('Concurrency fixture login succeeds', () => pm.expect(login.code).to.equal(200)); const token = login.json().refreshToken; const request = { url: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{baseUrl}}/auth/refresh'), method: 'POST', header: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ refreshToken: token }) } }; const pair = await Promise.all([send(request), send(request)]); const codes = pair.map(response => response.code).sort(); pm.test('Exactly one simultaneous refresh succeeds', () => pm.expect(codes).to.eql([200, 401])); const success = pair.find(response => response.code === 200).json(); const replay = await send({ url: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{baseUrl}}/auth/refresh'), method: 'POST', header: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ refreshToken: success.refreshToken }) } }); pm.test('Successful response token is rejected after concurrent replay detection', () => { pm.expect(replay.code).to.equal(401); pm.expect(replay.json().errorCode).to.equal('AUTH_INVALID_TOKEN'); }); })().catch(error => pm.test('Concurrent refresh scenario completes', () => { throw error; }));

item.name: Web refresh cookie login, rotation, CSRF checks, and logout

exec: const send = options => new Promise((resolve, reject) => pm.sendRequest(Object.assign({ disableCookies: true }, options), (error, response) => error ? reject(error) : resolve(response)));

const base = pm.variables.replaceIn('{{baseUrl}}'); const origin = 'http://localhost:8081'; const webHeaders = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Origin: origin, 'X-Auth-Transport': 'cookie' }; const cookieValue = response => { const header = response.headers.get('Set-Cookie'); return header ? header.split(';')[0] : null; }; const clearJar = () => new Promise((resolve, reject) => pm.cookies.jar().clear(base, error => error ? reject(error) : resolve()));
(async () => {

const login = await send({ url: base + '/auth/login', method: 'POST', header: webHeaders, body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ loginId: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{entitledLoginId}}'), password: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{entitledPassword}}') }) } }); const loginCookie = cookieValue(login); pm.test('Web login sets cookie attributes and omits Refresh from JSON', () => { pm.expect(login.code).to.equal(200); pm.expect(Object.keys(login.json()).sort()).to.eql(['accessToken','accountType','availablePoints','displayName','expiresIn','uuid']); pm.expect(login.headers.get('Cache-Control')).to.include('no-store'); pm.expect(loginCookie).to.be.a('string'); const setCookie = login.headers.get('Set-Cookie'); pm.expect(setCookie).to.include('HttpOnly'); pm.expect(setCookie).to.include('SameSite=Lax'); pm.expect(setCookie).to.include('Path=/auth'); pm.expect(setCookie).to.include('Max-Age=1209600'); pm.expect(setCookie.toLowerCase()).not.to.include('domain='); });

const blocked = await send({ url: base + '/auth/refresh', method: 'POST', header: Object.assign({}, webHeaders, { Origin: 'https://unapproved.example', Cookie: loginCookie }), body: { mode: 'raw', raw: '{}' } }); pm.test('Unapproved Origin is rejected before rotating the cookie session', () => pm.expect(blocked.code).to.equal(403));

const missingMode = await send({ url: base + '/auth/refresh', method: 'POST', header: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Origin: origin, Cookie: loginCookie }, body: { mode: 'raw', raw: '{}' } }); pm.test('Cookie auth with a missing transport header is forbidden', () => pm.expect(missingMode.code).to.equal(403));

const missingOrigin = await send({ url: base + '/auth/refresh', method: 'POST', header: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-Auth-Transport': 'cookie', Cookie: loginCookie }, body: { mode: 'raw', raw: '{}' } }); pm.test('Cookie auth with a missing Origin is forbidden', () => pm.expect(missingOrigin.code).to.equal(403));

const badLoginOrigin = await send({ url: base + '/auth/login', method: 'POST', header: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Origin: origin }, body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ loginId: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{entitledLoginId}}'), password: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{entitledPassword}}') }) } }); pm.test('Login rejects web Origin without its transport header', () => pm.expect(badLoginOrigin.code).to.equal(403));

const rotated = await send({ url: base + '/auth/refresh', method: 'POST', header: Object.assign({}, webHeaders, { Cookie: loginCookie }), body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ refreshToken: 'body-token-must-be-ignored' }) } }); const rotatedCookie = cookieValue(rotated); pm.test('Web refresh rotates only the cookie and ignores body Refresh', () => { pm.expect(rotated.code).to.equal(200); pm.expect(Object.keys(rotated.json()).sort()).to.eql(['accessToken','accountType','availablePoints','displayName','expiresIn','uuid']); pm.expect(rotated.headers.get('Cache-Control')).to.include('no-store'); pm.expect(rotatedCookie).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(rotatedCookie).not.to.equal(loginCookie); });

const malformed = await send({ url: base + '/auth/refresh', method: 'POST', header: Object.assign({}, webHeaders, { Cookie: 'auth.refreshToken=%' }), body: { mode: 'raw', raw: '{}' } }); pm.test('Malformed cookie returns AUTH_INVALID_TOKEN and clears cookie', () => { pm.expect(malformed.code).to.equal(401); pm.expect(malformed.json().errorCode).to.equal('AUTH_INVALID_TOKEN'); const cleared = malformed.headers.get('Set-Cookie'); pm.expect(cleared).to.include('Path=/auth'); pm.expect(Date.parse(cleared.split('Expires=')[1].split(';')[0])).to.be.below(Date.now()); });

const accessCookie = 'auth.refreshToken=' + login.json().accessToken; const accessRejected = await send({ url: base + '/auth/refresh', method: 'POST', header: Object.assign({}, webHeaders, { Cookie: accessCookie }), body: { mode: 'raw', raw: '{}' } }); pm.test('Access token in the Refresh cookie is rejected and cleared', () => { pm.expect(accessRejected.code).to.equal(401); pm.expect(accessRejected.json().errorCode).to.equal('AUTH_INVALID_TOKEN'); });

const nativeRefresh = await send({ url: base + '/auth/refresh', method: 'POST', header: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Cookie: accessCookie }, body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ refreshToken: decodeURIComponent(rotatedCookie.slice('auth.refreshToken='.length)) }) } }); pm.test('Native JSON Refresh ignores an invalid cookie header', () => { pm.expect(nativeRefresh.code).to.equal(200); pm.expect(nativeRefresh.json().refreshToken).to.be.a('string').and.not.be.empty; });

const logout = await send({ url: base + '/auth/logout', method: 'POST', header: Object.assign({}, webHeaders, { Cookie: rotatedCookie }), body: { mode: 'raw', raw: '{}' } }); pm.test('Web logout revokes session and clears cookie', () => { pm.expect(logout.code).to.equal(204); pm.expect(logout.headers.get('Cache-Control')).to.include('no-store'); const cleared = logout.headers.get('Set-Cookie'); pm.expect(cleared).to.include('HttpOnly'); pm.expect(cleared).to.include('Path=/auth'); pm.expect(Date.parse(cleared.split('Expires=')[1].split(';')[0])).to.be.below(Date.now()); });

const afterLogout = await send({ url: base + '/auth/refresh', method: 'POST', header: Object.assign({}, webHeaders, { Cookie: rotatedCookie }), body: { mode: 'raw', raw: '{}' } }); pm.test('Logout makes the last cookie unusable', () => { pm.expect(afterLogout.code).to.equal(401); pm.expect(afterLogout.json().errorCode).to.equal('AUTH_INVALID_TOKEN'); });

await clearJar(); const bypass = await send({ url: base + '/auth/refresh', method: 'POST', header: Object.assign({}, webHeaders, { Cookie: 'other=value' }), body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ refreshToken: rotatedCookie.slice('auth.refreshToken='.length) }) } }); pm.test('Body Refresh cannot bypass a missing web cookie and receives anonymous 204', () => pm.expect(bypass.code).to.equal(204));

const anonymous = await send({ url: base + '/auth/refresh', method: 'POST', header: Object.assign({}, webHeaders, { Cookie: 'other=value' }), body: { mode: 'raw', raw: '{}' } }); pm.test('Cookie-free web refresh ends as anonymous 204', () => pm.expect(anonymous.code).to.equal(204));

const emptyLogout = await send({ url: base + '/auth/logout', method: 'POST', header: Object.assign({}, webHeaders, { Cookie: 'other=value' }), body: { mode: 'raw', raw: '{}' } }); pm.test('Cookie-free web logout returns 204 and expires the cookie', () => { pm.expect(emptyLogout.code).to.equal(204); const cleared = emptyLogout.headers.get('Set-Cookie'); pm.expect(cleared).to.include('Path=/auth'); pm.expect(Date.parse(cleared.split('Expires=')[1].split(';')[0])).to.be.below(Date.now()); });
})().catch(error => pm.test('Web cookie auth scenarios complete', () => { throw error; }));
